Knowing a limit is always bad. I was playing this guy pool 30 years ago for $10 a game and down 6 games. I was convinced this guy I didn't know had to be a road player (player that travels from town to town), because I knew everyone in Houston who could beat me. I finally asked this guy David his last name, and he said Watson. I knew a David Watson pool player and thought he was just making up a name he knew. I asked to see his ID. For some reason he showed it to me. I guess he thought I was a sucker. Turns out there were more than one David Watson pool players and he lived in Houston. I won 8 games in a row and he quit. Confidence is everything.
